thread:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window for runtime-kernel v2.3.1 tonight 23:00 UTC to 01:00 UTC. Expected ~15m per region, rolling. There will be a compatibility pin to v2.3.0 fallback.

sarah: Noted. Can we prepare a status page entry and customer email template? Need clear impact: short interruption for Dedicated customers if rollback occurs.

devon: Oncall will watch canaries in us-east-1. If latency > 150ms p50 or error rate > 0.5% for 5m we halt and roll back. I'll add an automated canary hold.

monica: Drafting status update now. Proposed summary: "Planned maintenance: runtime kernel upgrade (v2.3.1) — rolling update with potential short interruptions for some Dedicated customers; automatic rollback available."

akira: Suggest adding steps customers should take: pin to v2.3.0 in their config, or enable fallback in routing policy. Small snippet:

"Affected services: Hosted API (no expected disruption), Dedicated clusters in single-region configs may see brief request rejections during fallback. Recommended action: pin model version or enable multi-region routing."

luis: Customer comm subject suggestion: "Planned maintenance: brief rolling runtime upgrade — Mar 19 23:00 UTC". Also add a quick FAQ: "Will my keys or data be affected? No."

sarah: Nice. Can you paste the statuspage body and email template here?

devon: Statuspage body (short): "We are performing a rolling kernel upgrade to improve GPU memory handling. Expected short interruptions for certain Dedicated clusters; the platform will automatically revert any problematic rollouts. We will post updates here if any customer impact is observed." 

monica: Email template (customer-facing):

Subject: Planned maintenance — rolling runtime upgrade (Mar 19, 23:00 UTC)

Hello,

We will perform a rolling runtime kernel upgrade on Mar 19 at 23:00 UTC. Most customers will see no change; Dedicated customers in single-region setups may experience brief rejected requests if an automatic rollback is triggered. No data or keys will be affected.

What to do:
- If you require uninterrupted capacity, pin to v2.3.0 for the window or enable multi-region routing.
- If you need help, reply to this email or open a support ticket.

We will update the status page if any impact occurs.

Thanks,
Redwood Support

akira: Add a short note for the status page updates cadence: "We will post at start, on rollback/hold, and at completion." Also include a quick internal playbook reference link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-rollbacks

sarah: OK I've scheduled the status page entry and queued the customer email. @devon please confirm canary thresholds in the deploy job.

devon: Confirmed. Canary thresholds set. I'll be watching and will post in this thread if we hit a hold.

deploy-bot: Deploy job started for runtime-kernel v2.3.1 — canary us-east-1 live.

devon: Canary looks good at +2m. No latency spikes.

devon: Rolling to other regions now.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete in us-west-2, eu-west-1. No holds triggered.

luis: Pinged a handful of Dedicated customers in case they'd like to opt to pin.

sarah: Nice work, marking comms sent. Closing follow-ups unless we see a rollback.

devon: All regions healthy. Marking as complete.

deploy-bot: Rollout finished successfully. Postmortem: none required.
